an5.53:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an5.53:1.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an5.53:1.6: samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
an5.53:1.8: yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvīkattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
an5.53:1.9: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahāṇāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an5.53:1.10: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
